brief:
Irish police raided the Dublin home of pro-Palestine donor Fergie Chambers and seized his property following a request by the Trump administration, the Irish Times reported. The operation targeted Chambers, who has supported Palestinian causes, in what marks an escalation of pressure on international figures engaged in pro-Palestine activity.

The raid represents a significant extraterritorial action by U.S. authorities, coordinating with Irish law enforcement to target a Dublin resident. Details on the specific grounds for the seizure and the nature of Chambers' alleged activities remain unclear from available reporting.
dek: Irish police raid Palestine donor Fergie Chambers’ Dublin home at behest of Trump Irish police have raided the Dublin home of pro- Palestine donor Fergie Chambers and seized his property after a request by the Trump administration, the Irish Times reports .
title: Irish police raid pro-Palestine donor's Dublin home at U.S. request
